trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Do you wish you know more about money?
trap.right: Do you wish you knew more about money?
trap.why: Wish + passado para desejo irreal. O brasileiro mantém o presente. Recomendação: I recommend that + base.

mcq.q: Do you wish you **___** more about money?
I recommend that he **___** a budget.

opts: I wish I had saved more.
I recommend to open an account.

fix.wrong: I wish I know how to invest.
fix.right: I wish I knew how to invest.

fix.wrong: She recommends that I opens an account.
fix.right: She recommends that I open an account.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I don’t know about money.” (I wish…)
rewrite.answer: I wish I knew about money.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “You should open an account.” (I recommend that you…)
rewrite.answer: I recommend that you open an account.
